'''Natural navigation''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]]. It could be bestowed upon an individual after several [[Standard year/Legends|months]] of attunement to a [[Turquoise crystal|turquoise]] [[tasar crystal]]. Natural navigation prevented an individual from getting lost as long as they had a map or a sense of the approximate direction they were heading in. If the individual had no bearings, they could still discern the direction of magnetic north.<ref name="J15" />
